title: Routing: analysis
why: Diagnosis with no stated answer. The plainest analysis task.
rubric: Does not hedge across several profiles

oracle.solution: analysis — the description states the work fully and it falls squarely in that profile.

prompt:
Classify the following piece of work into exactly one task profile.

The profiles are:
  filing    filing, renaming, recording. No judgement required.
  reading   search and summarise material that already exists.
  drafting  writing correspondence or documents addressed to a person.
  analysis  hard problems: diagnosing, reasoning, debugging.

If the description does not determine exactly one profile, answer 'unclear' and say what you would need to know. Do not guess.

Answer with one word — the profile name, or 'unclear' — then one sentence of justification.

The work:
  A numerical routine returns a single number where a spectrum was expected. Work out why.
